subject: GreenForge — Vendor master setup and PO / invoicing path
body_preview: Vendor requests master setup. Procurement Ops provides onboarding packet, DocuSign W-9 link, confirms PO/invoice routing and vendor ID once created.
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenforge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@greenforge.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Request to create vendor master - GreenForge, Inc.

Hi Mina,

Hope you9re well. We9re getting ready to set Redwood Inference up as a preferred vendor inside GreenForge and need to get GreenForge, Inc. added to your vendor master so we can receive POs and invoice for the upcoming projects. Can you share the vendor onboarding packet and confirm what information you need to create the record (legal name, EIN, remit address, primary AP contact, W-9 / tax docs, any vendor portal steps)? Also: what is your preferred method for receiving invoices (email, portal, EDI) and typical PO lead time once the profile is live?

We9re aiming to have our procurement and AP teams lined up quickly — happy to fill any forms you send.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenForge Inc.
procure@greenforge.com
Phone: (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: none yet — will return W-9 via DocuSign if requested.]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenforge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to create vendor master - GreenForge, Inc.

Hi Elena,

Welcome — glad to have GreenForge starting the process. Attached is our vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf). For a standard vendor master creation we need the following fields completed:

- Legal entity name (exact as on W-9 / certificate)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT if non-US)
- Registered address and remit address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name, email, phone
- Invoicing preference (email to AP, SFTP, vendor portal)
- Payment terms and currency (we default to NET30 unless otherwise agreed)
- Authorized signatory for contracting

We also require a completed W-9 (for US entities). You can sign securely via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/0A1B2C3D4E.

Once you return the completed form + W-9 we9ll:
1) Create the vendor master record and return a vendor number (VND-#####).
2) Confirm preferred PO routing and generate a sample PO so your team can validate invoice fields.
3) Add remittance instructions to the file and enable our AP to match invoices to POs.

Estimated timeline: 24-48 business hours after we receive complete documentation.

If you9re planning to send invoices via EDI or SFTP, please flag that now so we can provision the channel (this will add ~5 business days).

Looping in Kimberly (cc) from Vendor Onboarding — she9ll validate tax docs and run the vendor checks.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable PDF)

From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenforge.com>

Hi Mina,

Thanks — attached are the completed onboarding form and our signed W-9. Please confirm you have everything you need:

- Legal name: GreenForge, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Registered address: 220 Harbor Way, Suite 500, Emeryville, CA 94608
- Remit address: same as above (payments@greenforge.com is monitored by AP)
- AP contact: Jordan Blake (payables@greenforge.com) — phone (510) 555-9876
- Invoicing preference: PDF invoices via email to payables@greenforge.com; copy procure@greenforge.com for PO reconciliation.
- Payment terms: Net30 (per our agreement)

Attachments: GreenForge_completed_onboarding_form.pdf, GreenForge_W9.pdf (signed via DocuSign)

Question: do you require a countersigned master services agreement before POs start flowing or is vendor master + PO sufficient for initial work orders? Also, if you have a supplier portal, let us know and we9ll create the user for Jordan.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morris
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenForge Inc.
procure@greenforge.com

[Attachments: GreenForge_completed_onboarding_form.pdf; GreenForge_W9.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@greenforge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to create vendor master - GreenForge, Inc.

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the signed W-9 and completed form. I9ve created the vendor master record this morning. Details below: 

- Vendor ID: VND-99842
- Legal name on record: GreenForge, Inc.
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Remit address: 220 Harbor Way, Suite 500, Emeryville, CA 94608
- AP contact on file: Jordan Blake <payables@greenforge.com>, (510) 555-9876
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwoodinference.com (AP inbox) — please copy payables@greenforge.com for reconciliation; we will match to PO number in the invoice reference field.
- Accepted invoice formats: PDF (email), CSV via SFTP (by arrangement), EDI (requires setup).
- Default payment terms: NET30 (per note) — flag if you9ll need different terms for specific engagements.

I attached our remittance instructions document for your AP team (remittance_instructions.docx). We will issue POs once the contracting owner confirms the SOW. For straightforward engagements we can issue a PO without a countersigned MSA, but larger programs typically require a countersigned MSA first — that is handled by Legal/Contracts. If you want, I can open a Contracts request and let you know the expected timeline.

Next steps (summary):
- Your AP to send first invoice to invoices@redwoodinference.com with PO number in subject/body.
- We will create and share an initial sample PO (expected within 1 business day).
- Kimberly will run final tax validation and close the vendor onboarding checklist.

Internal note: Kimberly / Ben — please validate the W-9 and confirm tax classification in the next 24 hours; if anything looks off loop Legal. HubSpot company ID HS-4321789; attach paperwork to the company record.

Elena — let me know whether you9d like the sample PO sent to procure@greenforge.com or directly to Jordan.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: remittance_instructions.docx
